decisions.reason: The multi-model height-adjustable desk line is central to the firm's announced move toward flexible workplace solutions and represents substantial investment, so management will likely persist despite its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021.
The chair family sits close to the core offer, and furniture lifecycles are long, so a four-year-old chair range is still a normal part of the portfolio and is likely kept.

Dropping the flagship rug collection removes much of the strategic logic for the carpet floor cushions and their visibility has faded, but the multi-model investment and possible temporary market causes still tip management toward keeping them for now.

The high standing table supports the workplace and conference direction and fits post-pandemic office redesign, so management will likely attribute weak results to temporary market conditions and keep it.
